kql:
imWebSession
| where HttpStatusCode >= 500
| summarize ServerErrorCount = count()    by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where ServerErrorCount > 100

imWebSession
| summarize DistinctUserAgentCount = dcount(UserAgent), EventStartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EventEndTime = max(TimeGenerated)    by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where DistinctUserAgentCount > 1

imWebSession
| summarize DistinctUserAgentCount = dcount(UserAgent)    by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where DistinctUserAgentCount > 5

| where HttpStatusCode == 403
| summarize ForbiddenCount = count(), Urls = make_set(Url, 100), EventStartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EventEndTime = max(TimeGenerated)    by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| where ForbiddenCount > 100
